mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END), 0) AS balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 AND YEAR(t.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(t.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 1 AND YEAR(t.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(t.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 AND YEAR(t.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(t.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN t.amount WHEN c.type = 1 AND YEAR(t.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(t.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthBalance FROM finance_transaction t JOIN finance_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM finance_transaction t JOIN finance_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 2 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM finance_transaction t JOIN finance_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.create_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.create_time) = #{month} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC
